paragraphs: Plan on Sunday, fill every box with a short idea and tick it off as you post.

sections.heading: What the invoice tracker is
paragraphs: It is a landscape log with a row for each invoice, with the client, the date, the amount, the due date, when it was paid and its status.
It is drawn in your browser, and nothing you type is uploaded.

sections.heading: Why it helps
paragraphs: Late payments hurt small businesses. A list of what is owed and by whom makes follow-up easy.

sections.heading: Using it well
paragraphs: Fill it the day you send an invoice, and review the Due date column every Monday.

sections.heading: What the project tracker is
paragraphs: It is a landscape tracker with a row for each project and columns for the client, dates, fee, advance and status.
It is drawn in your browser, and nothing you type is uploaded.

sections.heading: Why it helps
paragraphs: When several clients pull at once, a list of deadlines prevents mistakes.

sections.heading: Using it well
paragraphs: Add a row when you accept a job. Check the Due column every morning.

sections.heading: What the client contact list is
paragraphs: It is a landscape contact list with a row for each person and columns for company, phone, email, city, last contact and notes.
It is drawn in your browser, and nothing you type is uploaded.

sections.heading: Why it helps
paragraphs: A paper list works when the phone is dead or a helper needs a number. It is also a backup.

sections.heading: Using it well
paragraphs: Fill it in as you meet people and review it once a month.
